_metadata.description: Job ergonomics: waits that survive the write deadline, request/result echo, result download, typed JSON submit, a role flag, and a network lane for remote tiers.

requirements.title: Waits outlive the server write deadline
requirements.description: WaitJob and WatchJob clear their per-request write deadline, and the CLI waits with no client timeout, re-issuing WaitJob once on Unavailable. A regression test serves the handler with a short write timeout and a slow fake provider.

validation.notes: handlers/jobs wait-deadline regression; internal/jobs network-lane test; live six-way parallel waits, jobs get echo, jobs download, typed --json submit, --role.

requirements.title: Job echoes its request and every result ref
requirements.description: The Job message carries a JobRequest (operation, model_id, backend, tier, role, prompt, negative_prompt, seed, width, height, variations, adapters) and repeated result_refs, populated from the stored payload; every variation output key is persisted, not only the first.

validation.notes: handlers/jobs wait-deadline regression; internal/jobs network-lane test; live six-way parallel waits, jobs get echo, jobs download, typed --json submit, --role.

requirements.title: jobs download and typed JSON submit
requirements.description: jobs download <id> [--index N] --out fetches a result through the blob endpoint; --json submit emits the typed SubmitAIResponse (job_id, estimated_seconds, model_id, tier, warnings); a --role flag maps to AIParams.openrouter_role.

validation.notes: handlers/jobs wait-deadline regression; internal/jobs network-lane test; live six-way parallel waits, jobs get echo, jobs download, typed --json submit, --role.

requirements.title: Remote tiers run on a network lane
requirements.description: JOB_LANE_NETWORK with a bounded worker pool (IMAGE_TOOLS_NETWORK_WORKERS, default 4) carries remote and byok-cloud tiers so they never queue behind the single local GPU worker; the selector stops emitting the CPU warning and CPU ETA for remote backends; fallback_policy is forwarded into the resolver.

validation.notes: handlers/jobs wait-deadline regression; internal/jobs network-lane test; live six-way parallel waits, jobs get echo, jobs download, typed --json submit, --role.
